title: Export center
idea: Export center: A scoped export request is followed by an explicit job record with permission, expiry and download state.
audience: People who need to retrieve export within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: Exports may take time or contain sensitive data.
avoidWhen: A link would expose data without checking current authorization.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its retrieve export priority and explicit commitment contract: Verify access at generation and download; do not invent completion or permanent retention.
navigation: Export center keeps the current retrieve export context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A scoped export request is followed by an explicit job record with permission, expiry and download state.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to retrieve export; exports may take time or contain sensitive data.
composition.priority: Verify access at generation and download; do not invent completion or permanent retention.

imagery.role: Support the actual retrieve export context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Show requested scope before job status and preserve a clear retry path.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the export center structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no retrieve export content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Verify access at generation and download; do not invent completion or permanent retention.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized retrieve export content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Verify access at generation and download; do not invent completion or permanent retention.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active retrieve export context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
